**Board comments: pin clicked, read-only preview** (CHR-1260 / CHR-1261). Pin #1 is active (`comment-pin` variant `active`, ring) and `comment-preview` is open next to it.

**Preview content (`comment-preview`, default):** a header with the thread number, the node id and a close button. The body holds the **latest messages** (up to 3, oldest first, built from `comment-message` with avatar, author, the Human/Agent badge and the relative time; older messages collapse into "N earlier messages" in the meta line). The footer holds the meta (message count · status) and the **"Open in Screens"** button (`chrome-btn` secondary-compact). The preview has **no composer and no Resolve**: reply and resolve happen in the Screens view.

**Behaviour**
- Opens on click / Enter / Space on a pin, **never on hover**.
- Light dismiss: a click outside, Esc, or a click on the same pin closes it. A click on another pin moves the preview to that pin (one preview at a time).
- "Open in Screens" switches to the Screens view, selects the screen and opens the same thread in its `comment-popover` (→ `comments-panel`).
- Board zoom or pan closes the preview.

**Implementation:** `<div popover="auto" role="dialog" aria-labelledby>` opened by the pin (`popovertarget` or `showPopover()`), which gives top layer, light dismiss and Esc for free. Position it with CSS anchor positioning: the pin gets `anchor-name`, the preview `position-anchor`, `position-area: inline-end span-block-end` and `position-try-fallbacks: flip-inline, flip-block` so it never leaves the canvas. Gate `inset: auto; margin: 0` inside `@supports (position-area: block-end)`. Without anchor positioning (Firefox today), fall back to JS: measure the pin's `getBoundingClientRect()` and set top/left, flipping at the canvas edges.

**Focus:** on open, focus moves to the close button. Tab order is close → "Open in Screens"; messages are static text. Esc or close returns focus to the pin. The pin carries `aria-expanded="true"`.
